# The President's veto on the 10th Sejm's record - F3's widened rule and the rates the game draws at, and B1 as first ruled, every miss

**F3** (Elias's ruling, widening B1): a statute is at risk when the President's backing party did not vote for it - a majority of its voting
members (the absent outside the count) voted no or abstained; a seeded draw then decides, at each president's own rate on that base, the pooled
rate for a president with no record. **B1** (Elias's ruling, COMPLETED.md s757, as first ruled): the President vetoes an ordinary statute when more
than half of the backing party's club members at the vote (absent included) voted NO. Read on `ElectionsData/poland/third_readings_term10.csv`
and `veto_record.csv` (the Sejm API's own record); the president is the one on the decision's day; budget acts and undecided acts are outside
every count; READING, stated: a referral to the Tribunal is a decided act and not a veto, so it counts in the widened base. The rates below are the runtime table
`Assets/Scripts/Elections/Generated/PolishVetoRates.cs`, written by the same run.
